아바타 느낌의 망월사
Use Image 4(망월사 이미지) as the Base, preserving the temple structure, mountain shapes, forest layout, perspective, and overall natural composition exactly as they are. Apply the alien-inspired style from Image 1, Image 2, and Image 3(아바타 캡쳐 이미지),but with stronger colors, richer bioluminescence, and more vivid fantasy accents, while still keeping the scene photorealistic and harmonious. Apply the following fantasy enhancements: • Transform the forest into a more vibrant alien ecosystem with enhanced bioluminescent flora:glowing leaves, neon-accented ferns, softly pulsating flowers in bright blues, purples, pinks, and turquoise hues. Add more visible glowing spores and floating particles throughout the air, similar to Image 2 and 3, creating a magical atmosphere. Reflect this colorful light softly on the temple roof tiles, wood carvings, and surrounding rocks to integrate them naturally into the fantasy environment. Replace the Base sky with a more vivid fantasy sky:a cosmic gradient of deep blues, purples, and emerald tones, plus a clearly visible gas-giant planet with swirling colors inspired by Image 1.Keep lighting angles consistent with the Base. Add a few small floating bioluminescent creatures or softly gliding fauna, but ensure they complement the scene rather than overwhelm it. Intensify color vibrancy overall while maintaining texture realism and environmental depth. Maintain full natural structure — no distortion, no removal of the temple, trees, or mountains. All added elements must blend seamlessly with the Base using correct shadows, reflections, haze, and depth. Output one final image at the same aspect ratio as the Base.
